description: This file defines an interface for assertions on Jsonifiable objects with a field selector and predicate, used to facilitate testing and validation within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: JsonifiableWithSelectorAndPredicateAssert
classes.description: An interface providing a custom assertion method for comparing Jsonifiable objects based on a field selector and predicate.

methods.name: hasEqualJson
methods.description: Asserts that the Jsonifiable fields selected and filtered by the given selector and predicate are equal between the actual and expected objects.
